versions.changelog: EPIPE fix: log() now wraps console.log in safeConsole() to swallow EPIPE; main.js installs a global uncaughtException / unhandledRejection listener so a closed stdout no longer kills the Electron main process. Cleaned stale diagnostic files (main-diag.js, main.js.new, test-app.js, longtest.js, _ovtest_*.txt, sandboxtest.txt). Added a 'main process killed by EPIPE' entry to the diagnostic checklist. Product version bumped to 0.1.2.

Repositioned from 'build an Electron wrapper' to 'diagnose and optimise the official harness desktop shell'. Documentation-only; explicitly NOT a Plugin (the product is an independent Windows desktop exe, not a Harness/OpenClaw extension). Added 'Known errors and diagnostic checklist' section covering harnessHome resolution failure, port-probe races, NODE_OPTIONS handling, sandbox/preload limits, plugin popups, packaging. Product version bumped to 0.1.1 (inferHarnessHome now also accepts source-only harnessHome).

Beta (pre-test) release. Not yet tested by the author; SKILL.md adds a beta notice section listing known untested items. Slug remains hidden during beta. Use 0.1.0-beta.1 / 0.2.0 etc. for next iterations after test feedback.

Initial release: dedicated skill for wrapping the locally-running DeepSeek Harness Web UI (http://127.0.0.1:3080) into an Electron desktop app. Split out from deepseek-harness-windows-deploy to keep each skill tightly scoped (addresses ClawHub SDI-1). Includes minimal-shell guidance plus a full scaffolding/packaging prompt that preserves Harness plugins and extension capabilities.
